_evidence: 0x00554fdd rotates the angle list at 0x89122c by the angle word [0x8911f8]: cos/sin of each are table lookups (|w|>>2 & 0xfffe into the static 0x2000-byte cosine table 0x7c5c5c, valid for every i16 as in geom_008943a0), and for i = 0.. until 'cmp ax,0x8000; je' the products go to 0x891236+2i and 0x89123e+2i. The list holds at most 4 angles: its fifth word 0x891234 is the last one before the first output 0x891236, so a longer list would read its own outputs (the game always terminates it there). Words 0..3 draw 0x8000 (the terminator, about 1/6 each, so 0..4 entries occur) or assorted angles over the whole range, word 4 is always 0x8000, [0x8911f8] is any i16 and the eight output words vary so every store is visible. No value faults.
